related.title: DIII-D 可重組 tokamak 研究
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對低長寬比與 Super-X 排熱研究；DIII-D 可重組 tokamak 研究改以磁形、診斷與核心邊緣整合為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on low aspect ratio and super-x exhaust research; DIII-D configurable tokamak research centers on magnetic shaping, diagnostics and core-edge integration, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照球形tokamak約束與可重組場形約束，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到DIII-D 可重組 tokamak 研究，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以排熱研究與電廠需求為起點，設計一項能區分「低長寬比與 Super-X 排熱研究」與「磁形、診斷與核心邊緣整合」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare spherical tokamak confinement with configurable magnetic shaping and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to DIII-D configurable tokamak research, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from exhaust research/plant needs and propose an observation distinguishing low aspect ratio and super-x exhaust research from magnetic shaping, diagnostics and core-edge integration, including uncertainty.

related.title: NSTX-U 球形電漿研究

related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.

practice: 對照球形tokamak約束與低aspect ratio約束，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。

以排熱研究與電廠需求為起點，設計一項能區分「低長寬比與 Super-X 排熱研究」與「球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare spherical tokamak confinement with low-aspect-ratio confinement and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to NSTX-U spherical-plasma research, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from exhaust research/plant needs and propose an observation distinguishing low aspect ratio and super-x exhaust research from spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics, including uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: MAST Upgrade 球形 tokamak
history.text: MAST Upgrade 球形 tokamak的公開資料展示低長寬比與 Super-X 排熱研究的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for MAST Upgrade spherical tokamak illustrate low aspect ratio and super-x exhaust research. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將低長寬比與 Super-X 排熱研究改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns low aspect ratio and super-x exhaust research into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
